trajectory_summary: This call runs on inbound energy the entire way — the customer is self-motivated, technically fluent, and drives most of the content himself. The rep never has to build energy because it was already high, but she also never runs the qualification gates this exact scenario (existing solar, wanting expansion) structurally requires, and the call closes on logistics alone.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag unknown; observed outcome is booked (day+time explicitly agreed) but the call's substance was carried by customer momentum, not rep-built energy — 'stagnant' in the sense that rep intent never had to work.
